title: KVeil: First-Place Solution to ECCV 2026 LifeGenIP Challenge on Unlearnable Videos
title_zh: 总结:KVeil：ECCV 2026 LifeGenIP“不可学习视频”挑战赛的冠军解决方案

paragraphs.en: KVeil在ECCV 2026 LifeGenIP挑战赛中提出了解决不可学习视频问题的冠军方案，保护了人脸视频免受未经授权的自定义处理。 The rapid development of personalized video generation has raised serious concerns over identity privacy, as a few facial videos of a person now suffice to reproduce their identity in synthetic videos. This report presents the first-place solutions to both phases of the ECCV 2026 LifeGenIP Challenge on Unlearnable Videos, which aims to protect facial videos from unauthorized customization under a limited and imperceptible perturbation budget. For Phase 1, we introduce Reference Capacity Collapse, a pair of complementary losses that degrade the information carried by the reference condition while keeping subsequent video representations dependent on it, together with a Motion-Guided EOT mechanism that improves robustness across unknown inference conditions. Phase 2 further considers tuning-based customization and unseen generative models. To address both threats within a single perturbation, we design a two-layer framework that protects the facial and background regions separately, constructing structure-aligned perturbations from a synthetic target identity in the former and strengthening the white-box disruption of Phase 1 in the latter. Our method achieves nearly perfect protection under white-box reference-based customization, and remains effective under other customization paradigms, various models, and temporal attacks. Both solutions are built upon our recent work LETHE. We hope our solutions can inspire future work on protecting facial videos against unauthorized customization. Our code is available at https://github.com/AntigoneRandy/KVeil.
paragraphs.zh: KVeil在ECCV 2026 LifeGenIP挑战赛中提出了解决不可学习视频问题的冠军方案，保护了人脸视频免受未经授权的自定义处理。个性化视频生成的快速发展引发了对身份隐私的严重担忧，因为现在只需少数几段某人的面部视频，就足以在合成视频中重现其身份。 本报告介绍了ECCV 2026 LifeGenIP挑战赛中“不可学习视频”问题两个阶段的冠军解决方案，该挑战旨在以有限且难以察觉的扰动预算，保护人脸视频免受未经授权的自定义处理。 在第一阶段中，我们提出了“参考容量坍缩”，这是一对互补的损失函数，能够削弱参考条件所携带的信息，同时保持后续视频表示对其的依赖性；此外，我们还引入了一种运动引导的EOT机制，以提升在未知推理条件下的鲁棒性。 第二阶段进一步考虑了基于调参的自定义以及未见过的生成模型。 为了在单次扰动内应对这两种威胁，我们设计了一个双层框架，分别保护人脸区域和背景区域：在前者中，从合成目标身份构建与结构对齐的扰动；在后者中，则强化第一阶段的白盒破坏能力。 我们的方法在白盒参考 기반自定义场景下实现了近乎完美的保护效果，并在其他自定义范式、多种模型和时间维度攻击下依然有效。 两种解决方案均基于我们近期的LETHE工作构建。 我们希望我们的解决方案能够启发未来在保护人脸视频免受未经授权自定义方面的研究。 我们的代码可在https://github.com/AntigoneRandy/KVeil获取。
